items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I recorded with Roy Brown... I played two jobs for him... I played with them twice

ctx.x: But he wasn't a brainiest soloist. Mm-hm. Yeah. I wanted to talk to you about recordings you may have made. And do you remember the first time you went to a recording studio? Yeah.
And the first time I went to a recording studio, I recorded with Roy Brown. Okay.
